## Overview

This manual provides the practical guide and problem set for **Lab 6: Classes**,
conducted as part of the Advanced Programming course (Spring Semester 2024) at Amirkabir University of Technology. 

Delivered as an online session on 17 April 2024,
the workshop was designed to give students hands-on experience with classes and OOP concepts in Java.
Students had to try the exercises on-site.
Solutions to exercises were later provided to them in video format with source code.
